text: Implemented P2 remote parity: bounded 4-byte framed/versioned protocol and typed opaque-script scheduler codecs; fixed system OpenSSH argv ending in scala-slurm-agent serve --stdio with no TTY and inherited user SSH authority; real FS2 bidirectional process runner with deadlines and independent bounded stderr/stdout; deployable agent main assembling the same SlurmCliScheduler under a required private workspace; capability handshake and negotiated frame ceiling; cursor-based remote logs; explicit degraded direct-SSH capability value; distinct protocol mismatch, agent absence, authentication, disconnect, remote CLI, and protocol diagnostics. Acceptance evidence: one local/framed-SSH scenario compares capabilities, submit, observe, accounting, and cancel; disconnect after accepted submit never calls cancel; three independent exchanges resume logs from supplied cursors; system runner /bin/cat test proves stdin/stdout lifecycle. Full suite: 62 tests green on Scala 3.3.8 and 3.8.4; formatting and agent/ssh packaging green. No real Slurm site or real SSH host compatibility is claimed by these deterministic tests; those remain later smoke/release gates.
